logp.method_description: The log P values corresponding to the octanol-water partition coefficient was adjusted to the solubility properties of the compounds.36 Complexes were dissolved in water, previously saturated with octanol with concentration 5x10-4 M. Into a 50 mL flask at 24oC with a magnetic stir bar was introduced initially 10 mL of octanol previously saturated with water and then 10 mL of the complex solutions in water. Two-phase mixture was stirred vigorously for 10 min. and samples, which were measured using ICP technique were taken from the separated phases.
